description: The report of which sources are in play (`describe_sources` / `describeSources`). `options` are the sources the application configures, with `{root}` standing for a fresh working directory: `system`, `user` and `project` (paths or null), `aux` (the sibling pattern or null), `dotenv` (`path`, `require_gitignored`) and `developer` (null for not opted in, or `{file}` -- the adapter writes its ecosystem's manifest naming that file). `files` builds the tree; `env` is the environment the kill switch is read from. `expect` is the whole report. The wording of a `not configured` developer reason is binding-specific and not covered here.

cases.name: everything switched off
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: every source configured
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     {root}/system.toml
  user config       {root}/user.toml
  project config    {root}/proj/.config.toml, {root}/proj/.config.*.toml
  .env file         {root}/.env
  developer config  {root}/.developer.toml -- configured, active

cases.name: a project file without siblings
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    {root}/.config.toml
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a custom sibling pattern
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    {root}/.config.toml, {root}/.local.*.toml
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a .env file that is not held to the guard
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         {root}/.env
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a guarded .env that passes
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         {root}/.env -- active (gitignored)
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a guarded .env that is not ignored
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         {root}/.env -- inactive (not covered by .gitignore)
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a guarded .env that does not exist
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         {root}/.env -- inactive (file not found)
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a guarded .env outside a git tree
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         {root}/.env -- inactive (not inside a git working tree)
  developer config  not opted in

cases.name: a developer file that is not ignored
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  {root}/.developer.toml -- configured, inactive (not covered by .gitignore)

cases.name: a developer file that does not exist
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  {root}/.developer.toml -- configured, inactive (file not found)

cases.name: a developer file outside a git tree
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  {root}/.developer.toml -- configured, inactive (not inside a git working tree)

cases.name: a dotenv developer file
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  {root}/.env.local -- configured, active

cases.name: the developer kill switch
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  {root}/.developer.toml -- configured, inactive (disabled by MYAPP_DEVELOPER_CONFIG=off)

cases.name: the kill switch is named after the app
cases.expect:
config sources:
  system config     disabled
  user config       disabled
  project config    disabled
  .env file         disabled
  developer config  {root}/.developer.toml -- configured, inactive (disabled by MY_APP_DEVELOPER_CONFIG=OFF)
